---
title: "US Economy - dateRangeInput"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
df <- economics
empty_plot <- function() {
  plotly_empty() |> layout(title = list(text = "No months match these inputs.", y = 0.5))
}
```

# Plots

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
dateRangeInput("dates", "Dates", start = min(df$date), end = max(df$date),
               min = min(df$date), max = max(df$date))
```

## Column

```{r}
#| title: Unemployed (thousands)
plotlyOutput("p1")
```

```{r}
#| title: Personal savings rate
plotlyOutput("p2")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Economic data
DTOutput("tbl")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
filtered <- reactive(df |> filter(date >= input$dates[1], date <= input$dates[2]))
output$p1 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(date, unemploy)) + geom_line())
})
output$p2 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(date, psavert)) + geom_line())
})
output$tbl <- renderDT(datatable(filtered()))
```
